how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:shaman-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3084:obj:0: Speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3084:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:3084:details:1: Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman ⟦E1⟧ Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3084:progress:0: Ah, welcome, ⟦2⟧. I'm pleased you have arrived. My days have become long and even busy what with so many students to teach, but the coming of one of your ilk brings me a great sense of accomplishment--I remember the days when I was taught by one of your shamans.
rows.quest:3084:completion:0: As you probably know, the elements give us our power. ⟦E2⟧, earth, water and air--these are our tools.
rows.quest:3084:completion:1: Our strength comes from the spirits of our ancestors. We are the leaders of our people. Like Thrall is to the ⟦E3⟧, so shall we be to the villages and towns we visit. They will look to us for wisdom and protection. To be better prepared, you must train often. When you feel you've gained more power, come to me and I shall teach you what I can.
rows.quest:3089:obj:0: Read the ⟦E4⟧ and speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3089:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:3089:details:1: Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman ⟦E1⟧ Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3089:progress:0: So, you've arrived. I was beginning to wonder when you would show yourself. I sent the parchment some time ago--I wasn't sure if it had arrived.⟦4⟧⟦5⟧But enough chatter... you're here because you have been chosen, chosen to lead the spiritual lives of our people.
rows.quest:3089:completion:0: You will be the conduit in which our ancestors communicate. You will have the power of the elements at your beck and call. Sundering your ⟦E5⟧ will be child's play; ⟦E6⟧ your ⟦E7⟧ as easy as breathing. Keep these things in mind as you face new challenges, and come back to me as often as you'd like. I will remain here to teach you new spells and set you on the correct path when you are ready.
rows.quest:3093:obj:0: Read the ⟦E8⟧ and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:3093:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦6⟧. I believe she was sent by the shaman ⟦E1⟧ Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.⟦7⟧
rows.quest:3093:progress:0: As quickly as water falls from the sky, here you are before me. I am pleased by your haste. It means you realize both the importance of our meeting and you being here. I am no leader, but I do understand the elements, and I can speak to the spirits of our people. I will teach you to do the same.
rows.quest:3093:completion:0: We will meet many times in the days to come. Each time you will hopefully leave my company a little more powerful... a little more prepared. Like the Eternal Flame, your spirit will burn bright and hot.
rows.quest:3093:completion:1: Go now, ⟦8⟧. Go and test yourself. I will be here for you when you need.
rows.quest:1516:obj:0: Bring 2 Felstalker Hooves to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:1516:details:0: The time is now, young ⟦9⟧. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. Following the shaman's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.
rows.quest:1516:details:1: The element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. But you must stand before the earth itself. If you are ready, then you will see things only shaman know of.
rows.quest:1516:details:2: Seek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:1516:progress:0: Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.⟦11⟧⟦12⟧The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.⟦13⟧⟦14⟧Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
rows.quest:1516:completion:0: Excellent. Your success shows that you are prepared.
rows.quest:1516:completion:1: Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. Earth will protect you, but only if shown the proper respect. Like the other elements, even earth can be fickle. Earth is the basis for life, and by observing its laws, you will gain greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets earth shares with you.
rows.quest:1516:completion:2: I shall make a sapta for you now, and by accepting it, you will realize your path.
rows.quest:1517:details:0: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.
rows.quest:1517:details:1: The sapta is always drunk in a holy place, and never anywhere else--remember that.
rows.quest:1517:details:2: Seek out ⟦E10⟧ Rock southwest of here--it is found at the end of the Hidden Path. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you shall see.
rows.quest:1517:completion:0: Ah... ⟦15⟧... pleased is the earth to have you here.
rows.quest:1517:completion:1: Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.
rows.quest:1517:completion:2: Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as ⟦E12⟧. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
